findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "security_app_check" references sensitive artifacts (.env, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: security_app_check · Private data: risk_token, x402_seller, x402_feed, security_app_check, risk_portfolio, evm_balance, evm_token_balance, evm_nonce, evm_transfers, crypto_price, dex_quote, evm_token_info, evm_portfolio · Public sink: risk_token, security_app_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: security_app_check · Private data: risk_token, x402_seller, x402_feed, security_app_check, risk_portfolio, evm_balance, evm_token_balance, evm_nonce, evm_transfers, crypto_price, dex_quote, evm_token_info, evm_portfolio · Public sink: risk_token, security_app_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
